summary.text: Long the centre of the Ebira-speaking people. Its people are Ebira Tao and speak the Okene dialect, the central dialect of Ebira.

history.text: The Ebira trace their migration from the Jukun country of present-day Taraba, with a stop at Idah. Okene LGA was created in 1976 from the old Ebira Division. The Ohinoyi of Ebiraland’s palace, the Azad Palace, is in Okene.
